title: Person: Wells
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Wells

anchor.prefix: would have a dead mass in the chapel like the way the fellows had told him it was when Little had died. All the fellows would be at the mass, dressed in black, all with sad faces.
anchor.suffix: too would be there but no fellow would look at him. The rector would be there in a cope of black and gold and there would be tall yellow candles on the altar and round the catafal
